entries.label: Amulet of Health
entries.summary: Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher.

entries.label: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location
entries.summary: While wearing this amulet, you are hidden from divination magic. You can't be targeted by such magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

entries.label: Amulet of the Planes
entries.summary: While wearing this amulet, you can use an action to name a location that you are familiar with on another plane of existence. Then make a DC 15 Intelligence check. On a successful check, you cast the plane shift spell.

entries.label: Animated Shield
entries.summary: While holding this shield, you can speak its command word as a bonus action to cause it to animate. The shield leaps into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free.

entries.label: Apparatus of the Crab
entries.summary: This item first appears to be a Large sealed iron barrel weighing 500 pounds. The barrel has a hidden catch, which can be found with a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check.

entries.label: Robe of Eyes
entries.summary: This robe is adorned with eyelike patterns. While you wear the robe, you gain the following benefits: * The robe lets you see in all directions, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. * You have darkvision out to a range of 120 feet.

entries.label: Robe of Scintillating Colors
entries.summary: This robe has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you wear it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cause the garment to display a shifting pattern of dazzling hues until the end of your next turn.

entries.label: Robe of Stars
entries.summary: This black or dark blue robe is embroidered with small white or silver stars. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while you wear it. Six stars, located on the robe's upper front portion, are particularly large.

entries.label: Robe of the Archmagi
entries.summary: This elegant garment is made from exquisite cloth of white, gray, or black and adorned with silvery runes. The robe's color corresponds to the alignment for which the item was created. A white robe was made for good, gray for neutral, and black for evil.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.label: Robe of Useful Items
entries.summary: This robe has cloth patches of various shapes and colors covering it. While wearing the robe, you can use an action to detach one of the patches, causing it to become the object or creature it represents. Once the last patch is removed, the robe becomes an ordinary garment.

entries.label: Rod of Absorption
entries.summary: While holding this rod, you can use your reaction to absorb a spell that is targeting only you and not with an area of effect. The absorbed spell's effect is canceled, and the spell's energy-not the spell itself-is stored in the rod. The energy has the same level as the spell when it was cast.

entries.label: Rod of Alertness
entries.summary: This rod has a flanged head and the following properties. Alertness. While holding the rod, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on rolls for initiative. Spells.

entries.label: Rod of Lordly Might
entries.summary: This rod has a flanged head, and it functions as a magic mace that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. The rod has properties associated with six different buttons that are set in a row along the haft. It has three other properties as well, detailed below. Six Buttons.

entries.label: Rod of Lordly Might (Battleaxe +3)

entries.label: Rod of Lordly Might (Spear +3)

entries.label: Rod of Rulership
entries.summary: You can use an action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of you. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 8 hours.

entries.label: Rod of Security
entries.summary: While holding this rod, you can use an action to activate it. The rod then instantly transports you and up to 199 other willing creatures you can see to a paradise that exists in an extraplanar space. You choose the form that the paradise takes.

entries.label: Rope of Climbing
entries.summary: This 60-foot length of silk rope weighs 3 pounds and can hold up to 3,000 pounds. If you hold one end of the rope and use an action to speak the command word, the rope animates. As a bonus action, you can command the other end to move toward a destination you choose.

entries.label: Rope of Entanglement
entries.summary: This rope is 30 feet long and weighs 3 pounds. If you hold one end of the rope and use an action to speak its command word, the other end darts forward to entangle a creature you can see within 20 feet of you. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become restrained.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Acid Arrow
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Acid Splash
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Aid
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Alarm
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-foot cube.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Alter Self (Aquatic Adaptation)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You assume a different form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration of the spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Alter Self (Natural Weapons)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You assume a different form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration of the spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Animal Friendship
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must see and hear you. If the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Animal Messenger
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within range, such as a squirrel, a blue jay, or a bat.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Animal Shapes
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Your magic turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. You transform each target into the form of a Large or smaller beast with a challenge rating of 4 or lower.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Animate Dead
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within range. Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an undead creature.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Animate Objects
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that are not being worn or carried.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Antilife Shell
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you and hedging out creatures other than undead and constructs. The barrier lasts for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Antimagic Field
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. A 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic surrounds you. This area is divorced from the magical energy that suffuses the multiverse.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Antipathy/Sympathy (Antipathy)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Antipathy choice. This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice. You target something within range, either a Huge or smaller object or creature or an area that is no larger than a 200-foot cube.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Antipathy/Sympathy (Antipathy, on an object)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Antipathy choice, on an object or an area. This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Antipathy/Sympathy (Sympathy)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Sympathy choice. This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice. You target something within range, either a Huge or smaller object or creature or an area that is no larger than a 200-foot cube.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Antipathy/Sympathy (Sympathy, on an object)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Sympathy choice, on an object or an area. This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Arcane Eye
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You create an invisible, magical eye within range that hovers in the air for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which has normal vision and darkvision out to 30 feet.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Arcane Hand
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand lasts for the spell's duration, and it moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Arcane Lock
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration. You and the creatures you designate when you cast this spell can open the object normally.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Arcane Sword
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration. When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Arcanist's Magic Aura
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You place an illusion on a creature or an object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Astral Projection
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane (the spell fails and the casting is wasted if you are already on that plane).

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Augury
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Awaken
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. After spending the casting time tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, you touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant. The target must have either no Intelligence score or an Intelligence of 3 or less.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Bane
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make charisma saving throws.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Banishment
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence. The target must succeed on a charisma saving throw or be banished.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Barkskin
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and the target's AC can't be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Beacon of Hope
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. This spell bestows hope and vitality. Choose any number of creatures within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Bestow Curse
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You touch a creature, and that creature must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Black Tentacles
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. For the duration, these tentacles turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Blade Barrier
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You create a vertical wall of whirling, razor-sharp blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Bless
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Blight
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Necromantic energy washes over a creature of your choice that you can see within range, draining moisture and vitality from it. The target must make a constitution saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Blindness/Deafness
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Blinded choice. You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Blindness/Deafness (deafened)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Blink
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Blur
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Branding Smite
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Burning Hands
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a dexterity saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Call Lightning
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. A storm cloud appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius, centered on a point you can see 100 feet directly above you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Calm Emotions
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Suppress choice. You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Calm Emotions (indifference)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Indifference choice. You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Chain Lightning
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Charm Person
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Chill Touch
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the creature to assail it with the chill of the grave.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Circle of Death
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point within range. Each creature in that area must make a constitution saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Clairvoyance
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Clone
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. This spell grows an inert duplicate of a living creature as a safeguard against death.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Cloudkill
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range. The fog spreads around corners.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Color Spray
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand. Roll 6d10; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can effect.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Command
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Command (Drop)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Drop choice. You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Command (Flee)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Flee choice. You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Command (Grovel)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Grovel choice. You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Command (Halt)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Halt choice. You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Commune
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Commune with Nature
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the land within 3 miles of you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Comprehend Languages
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Compulsion
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be charmed.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Cone of Cold
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. A blast of cold air erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a constitution saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Confusion
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. This spell assaults and twists creatures' minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Conjure Animals
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Conjure Celestial
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You summon a celestial of challenge rating 4 or lower, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The celestial disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

options.label: A celestial, CR 5 or lower (9th level)

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Conjure Elemental
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You call forth an elemental servant. Choose an area of air, earth, fire, or water that fills a 10-foot cube within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Conjure Fey
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You summon a fey creature of challenge rating 6 or lower, or a fey spirit that takes the form of a beast of challenge rating 6 or lower. It appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

options.label: A fey creature, CR 6 or lower
A fey spirit as a beast, CR 6 or lower

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Conjure Minor Elementals
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You summon elementals that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Conjure Woodland Beings
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You summon fey creatures that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Contact Other Plane
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other mysterious entity from another plane. Contacting this extraplanar intelligence can strain or even break your mind.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Contagion
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Blinding Sickness choice. Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, you afflict the creature with a disease of your choice from any of the ones described below.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Contagion (Filth Fever)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Filth Fever choice. Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, you afflict the creature with a disease of your choice from any of the ones described below.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Contagion (Flesh Rot)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Flesh Rot choice. Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, you afflict the creature with a disease of your choice from any of the ones described below.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Contagion (Mindfire)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Mindfire choice. Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, you afflict the creature with a disease of your choice from any of the ones described below.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Contagion (Seizure)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Seizure choice. Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, you afflict the creature with a disease of your choice from any of the ones described below.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Contagion (Slimy Doom)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Slimy Doom choice. Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, you afflict the creature with a disease of your choice from any of the ones described below.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Contingency
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Choose a spell of 5th level or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of 1 action, and that can target you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Continual Flame
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Control Water
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding water inside an area you choose that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side. You can choose from any of the following effects when you cast this spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Control Weather
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell. Moving to a place where you don't have a clear path to the sky ends the spell early.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Counterspell
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Create Food and Water
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Create or Destroy Water
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You either create or destroy water. **Create Water.** You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Create Undead
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small humanoids within range. Each corpse becomes a ghoul under your control.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Creation
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You pull wisps of shadow material from the Shadowfell to create a nonliving object of vegetable matter within 'range': soft goods, rope, wood, or something similar.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Cure Wounds
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Dancing Lights
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Darkness
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration. The darkness spreads around corners.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Darkvision
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Daylight
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. A 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Death Ward
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Delayed Blast Fireball
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. A beam of yellow light flashes from your pointing finger, then condenses to linger at a chosen point within range as a glowing bead for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Demiplane
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. The door is large enough to allow Medium creatures to pass through unhindered.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Detect Evil and Good
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Detect Magic
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Detect Poison and Disease
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you. You also identify the kind of poison, poisonous creature, or disease in each case.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Detect Thoughts
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Dimension Door
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Disguise Self
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You make yourself - including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person - look different until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Disintegrate
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. A thin green ray springs from your pointing finger to a target that you can see within range. The target can be a creature, an object, or a creation of magical force, such as the wall created by wall of force.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Dispel Evil and Good
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from fey, undead, and creatures originating from beyond the Material Plane.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Dispel Magic
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Divination
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Your magic and an offering put you in contact with a god or a god's servants. You ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The DM offers a truthful reply.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Divine Favor
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Divine Word
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You utter a divine word, imbued with the power that shaped the world at the dawn of creation. Choose any number of creatures you can see within range. Each creature that can hear you must make a Charisma saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Dominate Beast
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You attempt to beguile a beast that you can see within range. It must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Dominate Monster
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Dominate Person
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range. It must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Dream
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. This spell shapes a creature's dreams. Choose a creature known to you as the target of this spell. The target must be on the same plane of existence as you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Druidcraft
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range: - You create a tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Earthquake
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You create a seismic disturbance at a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Eldritch Blast
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Enhance Ability (Bear's Endurance)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Bear's Endurance choice. You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Enhance Ability (Bull's Strength)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Bull's Strength choice. You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Enhance Ability (Cat's Grace)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Cat's Grace choice. You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Enhance Ability (Eagle's Splendor)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Eagle's Splendor choice. You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Enhance Ability (Fox's Cunning)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Fox's Cunning choice. You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Enhance Ability (Owl's Wisdom)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Owl's Wisdom choice. You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Enlarge/Reduce
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Enlarge choice. You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller for the duration. Choose either a creature or an object that is neither worn nor carried.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Enlarge/Reduce (reduce)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Reduce choice. You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller for the duration. Choose either a creature or an object that is neither worn nor carried.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Entangle
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting form a point within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Enthrall
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you to make a wisdom saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Etherealness
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, in the area where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration or until you use your action to dismiss the spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Expeditious Retreat
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast this spell, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Eyebite
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Asleep choice. For the spell's duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dread power.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Eyebite (Panicked)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Panicked choice. For the spell's duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dread power.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Eyebite (Sickened)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Sickened choice. For the spell's duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dread power.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Fabricate
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You convert raw materials into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, and clothes from flax or wool.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Faerie Fire
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Any creature in the area when the spell is cast is also outlined in light if it fails a dexterity saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Faithful Hound
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration, until you dismiss it as an action, or until you move more than 100 feet away from it.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: False Life
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Fear
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Feather Fall
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Feeblemind
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range, attempting to shatter its intellect and personality. The target takes 4d6 psychic damage and must make an intelligence saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Find Familiar
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog (toad), hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish (quipper), rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Find Steed
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You summon a spirit that assumes the form of an unusually intelligent, strong, and loyal steed, creating a long-lasting bond with it.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Find the Path
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. This spell allows you to find the shortest, most direct physical route to a specific fixed location that you are familiar with on the same plane of existence.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Find Traps
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Finger of Death
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain. The target must make a constitution saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Fire Bolt
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Fire Shield
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. cold resistance choice. Thin and vaporous flame surround your body for the duration of the spell, radiating a bright light bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Fire Shield (fire)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. fire resistance choice. Thin and vaporous flame surround your body for the duration of the spell, radiating a bright light bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Fire Storm
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. A storm made up of sheets of roaring flame appears in a location you choose within range. The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10-foot cubes, which you can arrange as you wish.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Fireball
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Flame Blade
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a scimitar, and it lasts for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Flame Strike
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a dexterity saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Flaming Sphere
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a dexterity saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Flesh to Stone
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You attempt to turn one creature that you can see within range into stone. If the target's body is made of flesh, the creature must make a constitution saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Floating Disk
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Fly
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Fog Cloud
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Forbiddance
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space to a height of 30 feet above the floor.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Forcecage
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box, as you choose.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Forcecage (box)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Box choice. A prison in the shape of a box can be up to 10 feet on a side, creating a solid barrier that prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking any spells cast into or out from the area.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Foresight
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target can't be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Freedom of Movement
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You touch a willing creature.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Freezing Sphere
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. A frigid globe of cold energy streaks from your fingertips to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature within the area must make a constitution saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Gaseous Form
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You transform a willing creature you touch, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. The spell ends if the creature drops to 0 hit points. An incorporeal creature isn't affected.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Gate
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Geas
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You place a magical command on a creature that you can see within range, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action or course of activity as you decide.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Gentle Repose
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a corpse or other remains. For the duration, the target is protected from decay and can't become undead.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Giant Insect
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range into giant versions of their natural forms for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Glibness
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Globe of Invulnerability
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier springs into existence in a 10-foot radius around you and remains for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Glyph of Warding
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. acid explosive runes.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Glyph of Warding (cold)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. cold explosive runes.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Glyph of Warding (fire)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. fire explosive runes.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Glyph of Warding (lightning)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. lightning explosive runes.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Glyph of Warding (thunder)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. thunder explosive runes.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Goodberry
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one berry.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Grease
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Greater Invisibility
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Greater Restoration
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Guardian of Faith
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Guards and Wards
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You create a ward that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space (an area 50 feet square, or one hundred 5-foot squares or twenty-five 10-foot squares).

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Guidance
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Guiding Bolt
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Gust of Wind
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the spell's duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Hallow
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power. The area can have a radius up to 60 feet, and the spell fails if the radius includes an area already under the effect a hallow spell.

entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. With energy vulnerability, psychic. You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power.

entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. With extradimensional interference. You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power.

entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. With fear. You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power. The area can have a radius up to 60 feet, and the spell fails if the radius includes an area already under the effect a hallow spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Hallow (silence)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. With silence. You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Hallucinatory Terrain
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube in range look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Harm
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You unleash a virulent disease on a creature that you can see within range. The target must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 14d6 necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Haste
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Choose a willing creature that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Heal
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Choose a creature that you can see within range. A surge of positive energy washes through the creature, causing it to regain 70 hit points. This spell also ends blindness, deafness, and any diseases affecting the target.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Healing Word
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Heat Metal
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Hellish Rebuke
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Heroes' Feast
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You bring forth a great feast, including magnificent food and drink. The feast takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time, and the beneficial effects don't set in until this hour is over.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Heroism
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Hideous Laughter
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Hold Monster
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Choose a creature you can see within range. The target must make a saving throw of Wisdom or be paralyzed for the duration of the spell. This spell has no effect against the undead.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Hold Person
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another wisdom saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Holy Aura
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Divine light washes out from you and coalesces in a soft radiance in a 30-foot radius around you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Hunter's Mark
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Hypnotic Pattern
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Ice Storm
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the cylinder must make a dexterity saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Identify
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Illusory Script
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent illusion that lasts for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Imprisonment
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be bound by the spell; if it succeeds, it is immune to this spell if you cast it again.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Incendiary Cloud
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners and is heavily obscured.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Inflict Wounds
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Insect Plague
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Swarming, biting locusts fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The sphere spreads around corners. The sphere remains for the duration, and its area is lightly obscured.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Instant Summons
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or less.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Invisibility
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Irresistible Dance
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Choose one creature that you can see within range. The target begins a comic dance in place: shuffling, tapping its feet, and capering for the duration. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Jump
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a creature. The creature's jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Knock
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Choose an object that you can see within range. The object can be a door, a box, a chest, a set of manacles, a padlock, or another object that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Legend Lore
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Name or describe a person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about the thing you named.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Lesser Restoration
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Levitate
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. One creature or object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically, up to 20 feet, and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate a target that weighs up to 500 pounds.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Levitate (unwilling)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Unwilling choice. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a constitution saving throw is unaffected.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Light
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Lightning Bolt
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a dexterity saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Locate Animals or Plants
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Locate Creature
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Locate Object
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location, as long as that object is within 1,000 feet of you. If the object is in motion, you know the direction of its movement.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Longstrider
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mage Armor
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mage Hand
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magic Circle
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magic Circle (celestials)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Against celestials only. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magic Circle (elementals)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Against elementals only. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magic Circle (fey)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Against fey only. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magic Circle (fiends)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Against fiends only. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Keeps them in. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Keeps them in. Against celestials only. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Keeps them in. Against fey only. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Keeps them in. Against fiends only. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.
