entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Keeps them in. Against undead only. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magic Circle (undead)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Against undead only. You create a 10-­--foot-­--radius, 20-­--foot-­--tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magic Jar
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container you used for the spell's material component.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magic Missile
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magic Mouth
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You implant a message within an object in range, a message that is uttered when a trigger condition is met. Choose an object that you can see and that isn't being worn or carried by another creature.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magic Weapon
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Magnificent Mansion
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration. You choose where its one entrance is located. The entrance shimmers faintly and is 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Major Image
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mass Cure Wounds
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. A wave of healing energy washes out from a point of your choice within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on that point.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mass Heal
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you. You restore up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mass Healing Word
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mass Suggestion
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence up to twelve creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear and understand you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Maze
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes the maze. The target can use its action to attempt to escape.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Meld into Stone
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mending
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Message
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Meteor Swarm
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a dexterity saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mind Blank
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the charmed condition.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Minor Illusion
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mirage Arcane
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain. The terrain's general shape remains the same, however.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mirror Image
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Three illusionary duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Mislead
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You become invisible at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. The double lasts for the duration, but the invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Misty Step
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Modify Memory
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You attempt to reshape another creature's memories. One creature that you can see must make a wisdom saving throw. If you are fighting the creature, it has advantage on the saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Moonbeam
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, dim light fills the cylinder.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Move Earth
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side within range. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Nondetection
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from divination magic. The target can be a willing creature or a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Pass without Trace
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Passwall
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. A passage appears at a point of your choice that you can see on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, a ceiling, or a floor) within range, and lasts for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Phantasmal Killer
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature. The target must make a wisdom saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Phantom Steed
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. A Large quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. You decide the creature's appearance, but it is equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Planar Ally
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid. The being must be known to you: a god, a primordial, a demon prince, or some other being of cosmic power.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Planar Binding
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. With this spell, you attempt to bind a celestial, an elemental, a fey, or a fiend to your service. The creature must be within range for the entire casting of the spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Plane Shift
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Plane Shift (Banish)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Banish choice. Choose a creature within your reach and make a melee spell attack against it. On a hit, the creature must make a charisma saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Plant Growth
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. This spell channels vitality into plants within a specific area. There are two possible uses for the spell, granting either immediate or long-term benefits.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Poison Spray
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 poison damage.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Polymorph
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form. An unwilling creature must make a wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. A shapechanger automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Polymorph (unwilling)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Unwilling choice. An unwilling creature must make a wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. A shapechanger automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Power Word Kill
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly. If the creature you choose has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Power Word Stun
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is stunned. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Prayer of Healing
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Prestidigitation
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Prismatic Spray
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand. Each ray is a different color and has a different power and purpose. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a dexterity saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Prismatic Wall
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall-up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick-centered on a point you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Private Sanctum
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You make an area within range magically secure. The area is a cube that can be as small as 5 feet to as large as 100 feet on each side. The spell lasts for the duration or until you use an action to dismiss it.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Produce Flame
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A flickering flame appears in your hand. The flame remains there for the duration and harms neither you nor your equipment. The flame sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Produce Flame (held)
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Held choice. A flickering flame appears in your hand. The flame remains there for the duration and harms neither you nor your equipment. The flame sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Programmed Illusion
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You create an illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range that activates when a specific condition occurs. The illusion is imperceptible until then.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Project Image
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration. The copy can appear at any location within range that you have seen before, regardless of intervening obstacles.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Protection from Energy
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. acid resistance choice. For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Protection from Energy (cold)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. cold resistance choice. For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Protection from Energy (fire)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. fire resistance choice. For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Protection from Energy (lightning)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. lightning resistance choice. For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Protection from Energy (thunder)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. thunder resistance choice. For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Protection from Evil and Good
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. The protection grants several benefits.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Protection from Poison
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. If more than one poison afflicts the target, you neutralize one poison that you know is present, or you neutralize one at random.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Purify Food and Drink
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Raise Dead
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days. If the creature's soul is both willing and at liberty to rejoin the body, the creature returns to life with 1 hit point.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Ray of Enfeeblement
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Ray of Frost
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Regenerate
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability. The target regains 4d8 + 15 hit points.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Reincarnate
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You touch a dead humanoid or a piece of a dead humanoid. Provided that the creature has been dead no longer than 10 days, the spell forms a new adult body for it and then calls the soul to enter that body.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Remove Curse
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Resilient Sphere
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range. An unwilling creature must make a dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is enclosed for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Resistance
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw. The spell then ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Resurrection
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, that didn't die of old age, and that isn't undead. If its soul is free and willing, the target returns to life with all its hit points.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Reverse Gravity
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot high cylinder centered on a point within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Revivify
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Rope Trick
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long. One end of the rope then rises into the air until the whole rope hangs perpendicular to the ground.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Sacred Flame
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Sanctuary
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You ward a creature within range against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a wisdom saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Scorching Ray
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Scrying
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Secret Chest
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane. You must touch the chest and the miniature replica that serves as a material component for the spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: See Invisibility
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. For the duration of the spell, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see through Ethereal. The ethereal objects and creatures appear ghostly translucent.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Seeming
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. This spell allows you to change the appearance of any number of creatures that you can see within range. You give each target you choose a new, illusory appearance.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Sending
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Sequester
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. By means of this spell, a willing creature or an object can be hidden away, safe from detection for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Shapechange
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. You assume the form of a different creature for the duration. The new form can be of any creature with a challenge rating equal to your level or lower.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Shatter
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-­--foot-­--radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Shield
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Shield of Faith
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Shillelagh
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. The wood of a club or a quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Shocking Grasp
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Silence
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Silent Image
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube. The image appears at a spot within range and lasts for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Simulacrum
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range for the entire casting time of the spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Sleep
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Sleet Storm
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. The area is heavily obscured, and exposed flames in the area are doused.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Slow
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range. Each target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Spare the Dying
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Speak with Animals
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Speak with Dead
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer the questions you pose. The corpse must still have a mouth and can't be undead.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Speak with Plants
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Spider Climb
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Spike Growth
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes difficult terrain for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Spirit Guardians
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. If you are good or neutral, their spectral form appears angelic or fey (your choice).

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Spiritual Weapon
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Stinking Cloud
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Stone Shape
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Stoneskin
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone. Until the spell ends, the target has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Storm of Vengeance
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet. Lightning flashes in the area, thunder booms, and strong winds roar.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Suggestion
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Sunbeam
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a constitution saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Sunburst
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 8 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in that light must make a constitution saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Symbol
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Death.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Symbol (discord)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Discord.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Symbol (fear)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Fear.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Symbol (hopelessness)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Hopelessness.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Symbol (insanity)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Insanity.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Symbol (pain)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Pain.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Symbol (sleep)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Sleep.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Symbol (stunning)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. Stunning.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Telekinesis
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Telepathic Bond
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Teleport
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 7 spell, used up when read: save DC 18, attack bonus +10. This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Teleportation Circle
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Thaumaturgy
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range. You create one of the following magical effects within range. - Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Thunderwave
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a constitution saving throw.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Time Stop
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Tiny Hut
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell ends if you leave its area.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Tongues
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Transport via Plants
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. This spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Tree Stride
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be living and at least the same size as you.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: True Polymorph
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: True Polymorph (creature into an object)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. Creature into Object. The creature's statistics become those of the object; an unwilling creature saves on Wisdom.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: True Polymorph (object into a creature)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. Object into Creature. Any kind of creature of challenge 9 or lower, friendly to you, acting on each of your turns as you decide.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: True Polymorph (unwilling)
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. Unwilling choice. This spell has no effect on a shapechanger or a creature with 0 hit points. An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom saving throw, and if it succeeds, it isn't affected by this spell.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: True Resurrection
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age. If the creature's soul is free and willing, the creature is restored to life with all its hit points.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: True Seeing
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. This spell gives the willing creature you touch the ability to see things as they actually are.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: True Strike
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range. Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target's defenses.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Unseen Servant
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 1 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends. The servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Vampiric Touch
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon life force from others to heal your wounds. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Vicious Mockery
entries.summary: A scroll of a cantrip, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Wall of Fire
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 4 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Wall of Force
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. An invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Wall of Ice
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-square panels.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Wall of Stone
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 5 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Wall of Thorns
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You create a wall of tough, pliable, tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns. The wall appears within range on a solid surface and lasts for the duration.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Warding Bond
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. This spell wards a willing creature you touch and creates a mystic connection between you and the target until the spell ends.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Water Breathing
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. This spell gives a maximum of ten willing creatures within range and you can see, the ability to breathe underwater until the end of its term. Affected creatures also retain their normal breathing pattern.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Water Walk
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface-such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava-as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat).

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Web
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range. The webs fill a 20-foot cube from that point for the duration. The webs are difficult terrain and lightly obscure their area.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Weird
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 9 spell, used up when read: save DC 19, attack bonus +11. Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you create illusory creatures in their minds, visible only to them.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Wind Walk
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You and up to ten willing creatures you can see within range assume a gaseous form for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Wind Wall
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 3 spell, used up when read: save DC 15, attack bonus +7. A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Word of Recall
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 6 spell, used up when read: save DC 17, attack bonus +9. You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary.

entries.label: Spell Scroll: Zone of Truth
entries.summary: A scroll of a level 2 spell, used up when read: save DC 13, attack bonus +5. You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range.

entries.label: Spellguard Shield
entries.summary: While holding this shield, you have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attacks have disadvantage against you.

entries.label: Sphere of Annihilation
entries.summary: This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it. The sphere obliterates all matter it passes through and all matter that passes through it. Artifacts are the exception.

entries.label: Staff of Charming
entries.summary: While holding this staff, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 10 charges to cast charm person, command, or comprehend languages from it using your spell save DC. The staff can also be used as a magic quarterstaff.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.label: Staff of Fire
entries.summary: You have resistance to fire damage while you hold this staff. The staff has 10 charges.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.label: Staff of Frost
entries.summary: You have resistance to cold damage while you hold this staff. The staff has 10 charges.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.label: Staff of Healing
entries.summary: This staff has 10 charges.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a bard, cleric, or druid

entries.label: Staff of Power
entries.summary: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls. The staff has 20 charges for the following properties.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.label: Staff of Striking
entries.summary: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. The staff has 10 charges. When you hit with a melee attack using it, you can expend up to 3 of its charges. For each charge you expend, the target takes an extra 1d6 force damage.

entries.label: Staff of Swarming Insects
entries.summary: This staff has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, a swarm of insects consumes and destroys the staff, then disperses. Spells.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.label: Staff of the Magi
entries.summary: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While you hold it, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls. The staff has 50 charges for the following properties. It regains 4d6 + 2 expended charges daily at dawn.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.label: Staff of the Python
entries.summary: You can use an action to speak this staff's command word and throw the staff on the ground within 10 feet of you. The staff becomes a giant constrictor snake under your control and acts on its own initiative count.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a cleric, druid, or warlock

entries.label: Staff of the Woodlands
entries.summary: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls. The staff has 10 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn.

entries.label: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
entries.summary: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. It also has the following additional properties. When one of these properties is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn. Lightning.

entries.label: Staff of Withering
entries.summary: This staff has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. The staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff. On a hit, it deals damage as a normal quarterstaff, and you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 necrotic damage to the target.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a cleric, druid, or warlock

entries.label: Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals
entries.summary: If the stone is touching the ground, you can use an action to speak its command word and summon an earth elemental, as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell. The stone can't be used this way again until the next dawn. The stone weighs 5 pounds.

entries.label: Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone)
entries.summary: While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.

entries.label: Sun Blade
entries.summary: This item appears to be a longsword hilt. While grasping the hilt, you can use a bonus action to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence, or make the blade disappear. While the blade exists, this magic longsword has the finesse property.

entries.label: Sword of Life Stealing (Greatsword)
entries.summary: When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 3d6 necrotic damage, provided that the target isn't a construct or an undead. You gain temporary hit points equal to the extra damage dealt.

entries.label: Sword of Life Stealing (Longsword)
entries.summary: When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 3d6 necrotic damage, provided that the target isn't a construct or an undead. You gain temporary hit points equal to the extra damage dealt.

entries.label: Sword of Life Stealing (Rapier)
entries.summary: When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 3d6 necrotic damage, provided that the target isn't a construct or an undead. You gain temporary hit points equal to the extra damage dealt.

entries.label: Sword of Life Stealing (Shortsword)
entries.summary: When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 3d6 necrotic damage, provided that the target isn't a construct or an undead. You gain temporary hit points equal to the extra damage dealt.

entries.label: Sword of Sharpness (Greatsword)
entries.summary: When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target. When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 4d6 slashing damage. Then roll another d20.

entries.label: Sword of Sharpness (Longsword)
entries.summary: When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target. When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 4d6 slashing damage. Then roll another d20.

entries.label: Sword of Sharpness (Scimitar)
entries.summary: When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target. When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 4d6 slashing damage. Then roll another d20.

entries.label: Sword of Sharpness (Shortsword)
entries.summary: When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target. When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 4d6 slashing damage. Then roll another d20.

entries.label: Sword of Wounding (Greatsword)
entries.summary: Hit points lost to this weapon's damage can be regained only through a short or long rest, rather than by regeneration, magic, or any other means. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon, you can wound the target.

entries.label: Sword of Wounding (Longsword)
entries.summary: Hit points lost to this weapon's damage can be regained only through a short or long rest, rather than by regeneration, magic, or any other means. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon, you can wound the target.

entries.label: Talisman of Pure Good
entries.summary: This talisman is a mighty symbol of goodness. A creature that is neither good nor evil in alignment takes 6d6 radiant damage upon touching the talisman. An evil creature takes 8d6 radiant damage upon touching the talisman.

binds.restriction: Requires attunement by a creature of good alignment

entries.label: Talisman of the Sphere
entries.summary: When you make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to control a sphere of annihilation while you are holding this talisman, you double your proficiency bonus on the check.

entries.label: Talisman of Ultimate Evil
entries.summary: This item symbolizes unrepentant evil. A creature that is neither good nor evil in alignment takes 6d6 necrotic damage upon touching the talisman. A good creature takes 8d6 necrotic damage upon touching the talisman.

entries.summary: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the fireball spell (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend.

entries.label: Wand of Paralysis
entries.summary: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cause a thin blue ray to streak from the tip toward a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute.

entries.label: Wand of Secrets
